name: The Goodtime Barbershop

reviews.text: I just got my haircut here for the first time and it’s now the only place I’m going to. Rachael is awesome, I enjoyed the conversation and not expecting the beard trim but thankful for the assist. Both Crystal and Rachael were welcoming, wishing me a Merry Christmas when I left. Coming back in 3 weeks for sure!
reviews.author: Russell Castillo

reviews.text:
I can't believe it's taken me this long to write a review, but I can't recommend this place enough. Crystal and Rachael are the best. I've been coming here for what must be 5 years now and have never once left with anything but a great haircut. Remembered to leave a review today after another 10/10 haircut and a new hair product recommendation that finally seems like the perfect one for my hair type

Can't imagine going anywhere else
reviews.author: Jaron Thatcher

reviews.text: I was in the need of some major hair therapy, so I dropped in hoping they could see me the same day. My wife insisted I grow my hair long so I went with a mullet.  Rachael took me as a walk in even though they prefer appointments. She had me looking good within a half hour.
reviews.author: 600miles

reviews.text:
Best haircut and beard trim I’ve had in years. Did a phenomenal job making new lines and cleaning up my beard. Blended the haircut perfectly.
Also really enjoyable company and atmosphere. Folks waiting to get their hair cut, the barbers, and those sitting in the chair have a fun a fluid conversation.
It’s my place now.
reviews.author: Johann Lockard

reviews.text: The name is spot on for this place! I have never had a bad experience here both of the barber are such amazing and sweet people have had my hair cut by both of them but I see Rachael. She is such an amazing person keeps good conversations but doesn't make me feel like I need to talk the whole time. She goes above and beyond for me. I highly recommend this place and then just moved into their new store front and it is beautiful. I am also a trans person and they are very excepting which can be hard to find in the valley sometimes.
reviews.author: Henry Taylor
